summary: Our project is a game that helps children learn about abandoned machines left in space.
details:
Our new project idea is to create an educational game for children.

The main goal of this game is to help children learn more about different people and discover new information in a fun and interactive way.

First, we will create a game using the program we have developed. The game will include a series of questions and interactive activities. Children will answer these questions, explore different topics, and learn new things through the experience.

We also want to make the game more interesting by adding a virtual environment, where children can interact, explore, and learn instead of just reading information.

In conclusion, our goal is to combine education and entertainment to make learning easier, more enjoyable, and more effective for children.
